description: A minecraft mod and plugin based on OpenBoatUtils and TimingSystem, for better realism

mods.name: IBRealistic
mods.description: Realistic rally physics for Minecraft boats. Features four-wheel dynamics, tire grip model, weight transfer, differentials (Open/Locked/LSD), surface-specific friction for 300+ blocks, weather conditions, aerodynamic downforce, and visual wheels with steering wheel.
